added_date_rules:
Calendar date windows:
For date-based calendar windows on timestamp columns, use half-open bounds: timestamp_column >= start AND timestamp_column < exclusive_end. The exclusive end is the start of the next requested calendar period, or the day after an inclusive final date. An inclusive upper comparison to a bare date ends at midnight and omits later timestamps on that final day. Preserve explicitly requested exact-time comparisons and duration thresholds.
limitations: One run per configuration; dev tuning; latency can vary with hardware/runtime state; not human-reviewed test accuracy.
